# quality.quality_events

<!-- Generated by dctl from the contract. Do not edit by hand. -->

One row per defect recorded at an inspection point. The inspector is carried as a pseudonymous identifier only, so the table can be shared for analysis without exposing who recorded each event.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Contract | `contracts/quality_events.yaml`, version 1.0.0, active |
| Unity Catalog name | `gold_dev.quality.quality_events` |
| Storage location | `abfss://gold-shared@stbridgedev.dfs.core.windows.net/quality/quality_events` |
| Owner | Quality Engineering Data (`dp-quality-owners`) |
| Steward | `dp-quality-stewards` |
| Primary key | `event_id` |
| Clustered by | `site_code`, `event_ts` |
| Highest classification | confidential |
| Contains personal data | yes |
| Fabric exposure | shortcut |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Required | Classification | Checks | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `event_id` (key) | `STRING` | yes | internal | pattern `^QE-[0-9A-F]{12}$` | Unique identifier of the quality event. |
| `event_ts` | `TIMESTAMP` | yes | internal |  | When the defect was recorded, in UTC. |
| `site_code` | `STRING` | yes | internal | pattern `^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{2}$` | Code of the site where the defect was found. |
| `asset_id` | `STRING` | yes | internal | pattern `^AST-[0-9]{6}$` | Asset that produced the defective units. |
| `defect_code` | `STRING` | yes | internal | pattern `^[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{3}$` | Code from the defect catalogue. |
| `severity` | `STRING` | yes | internal | one of `minor`, `major`, `critical` | Severity assigned at inspection. |
| `quantity_affected` | `INT` | yes | internal | min 1 | Units affected by the defect. |
| `inspector_pseudo_id` | `STRING` | yes | confidential, pii | pattern `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` | Salted hash of the inspector identifier. Never reversible in this table. |
| `is_customer_reported` | `BOOLEAN` | yes | internal |  | True when the defect came from a customer complaint. |
